The structure of K8Rb4Tl4Br24 (reduced formula K2RbTlBr6) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 216), with 40 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral environments for both Rb and Tl centers, each coordinated by six Br neighbors, while K centers show a close-packed-like arrangement with 12 Br neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Rb and Tl octahedra and face-sharing between K and both Rb and Tl polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 40 sites.
